description:
Every night, Jaehyun (uke) meets the same mysterious man in his dreams. At first, he brushes it off as nothing more than a strange coincidence. But one day, while working as a stage director for a small theater troupe, Jaehyun is stunned to discover that the actor Woojae (seme) is the very person who has been appearing in his dreams. Flustered by the uncanny overlap between dream and reality, Jaehyun tries his best to avoid him. Unfortunately, Woojae’s boundless sociability makes that impossible, as he persistently closes the distance between them…

**Original Webtoon:**   
[Lezhin](https://www.lezhin.com/ko/comic/day_dream), [Bomtoon](https://www.bomtoon.com/detail/day_dream), [MrBlue](https://www.mrblue.com/webtoon/wt_000077459), [Naver Series](https://series.naver.com/comic/detail.series?productNo=13918209), [BookCube](https://www.bookcube.com/toon/detail.asp?webtoon_num=260234)
